motion.use: the composer caret following the insertion point
motion.note: Shorter than any feedback: the caret trails each keystroke, and a glide any longer reads as lag.

motion.use: a control answering hover, press or focus: its colour, background, border, shadow, or a small turn or slide of its own parts
content entering the chat area: an opened row's body, and each streamed piece of the answer
motion.note: The host's own chat-area entrances (MessageItem, the turn navigator's preview) run 120 ms; the skin's entrances match them.

motion.use: one message the reader sends growing into its row, and the same growth on the Motion tab's card
a floating surface or a group of controls appearing: popover cards, menus, panels, the search dialog, a toast, a strip fading in
a surface leaving on the reader's dismissal: a menu or a dialog closing, the overtime badge leaving
motion.note: Shorter than the entrance: once the reader has dismissed it, the surface is in the way.

motion.use: a surface growing out of its anchor: a menu out of its trigger, a full-window dialog out of the centre, a settings page sliding in, the overtime badge sliding onto its line
motion.note: transitions.dev's "Menu dropdown", "Modal open / close", "Page side-by-side" and "Notification badge" (MIT).

motion.use: each half of a wording swap: the old words leaving, the new ones arriving
motion.note: transitions.dev's "Text states swap" (MIT).

motion.use: the offset the words arriving start after the words leaving, so the two halves of a wording swap travel together
how long after a field empties the streak under its cleared words starts to rise

motion.use: one pass of the highlight band across the waiting line's words and a running process group's header

motion.use: how long the highlight band waits after its words appear before its first pass

motion.use: one turn of the settings page's waiting-line preview: one wording standing, leaving, and standing again
motion.note: The swap's own travel, blur and curve are the ones shared/motion.css carries; the leave and the arrival take the same fifth of the turn as the swap takes of this period (0.15 s and its 0.05 s gap).

motion.note: The arrival takes the same share of this turn for a sample of any length (settings-tab-motion.ts), and each character fades over --dsh-tg-duration-reveal, the fade the conversation itself runs.

motion.use: one turn of the settings page's caret preview: the sample line typed out, then standing whole before the next turn
motion.note: The typing takes the same share of this turn for a sample of any length (settings-tab-motion.ts), and each new place is reached over --dsh-tg-duration-instant, the glide the composer's own caret takes; the rest of the turn is the stand, where the caret blinks on --dsh-tg-period-blink.

motion.use: one turn of the Motion tab's message-entrance card: one message arriving, standing, and giving way to the next
motion.note: The arriving message takes --dsh-tg-duration-enter of the turn; the rest of it is the stand.
